assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The claim pertains to episode ep-05054.
The claim was submitted with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events.
The payer SilverBridge issued a letter inviting submission of supporting clinical documentation.
The documentation is submitted as supporting clinical justification of medical necessity for the service.
